sql: SELECT order_year, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents, SUM(gross_profit_cents) AS gross_profit_cents, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(gross_profit_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0), 6) AS gross_margin_rate FROM order_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year

WITH yearly AS (SELECT city, order_year, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS revenue FROM order_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY city, order_year), pivoted AS (SELECT city, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_cents FROM yearly GROUP BY city) SELECT city, revenue_2024_cents, revenue_2025_cents, ROUND(1.0 * (revenue_2025_cents - revenue_2024_cents) / NULLIF(revenue_2024_cents, 0), 6) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM pivoted ORDER BY revenue_2025_cents DESC, city

WITH yearly AS (SELECT channel, channel_kind, order_year, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS revenue FROM order_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY channel, channel_kind, order_year), pivoted AS (SELECT channel, channel_kind, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_cents FROM yearly GROUP BY channel, channel_kind) SELECT channel, channel_kind, revenue_2024_cents, revenue_2025_cents, ROUND(1.0 * revenue_2025_cents / SUM(revenue_2025_cents) OVER (), 6) AS contribution_2025_rate, ROUND(1.0 * (revenue_2025_cents - revenue_2024_cents) / NULLIF(revenue_2024_cents, 0), 6) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM pivoted ORDER BY revenue_2025_cents DESC

SELECT category, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents, SUM(gross_profit_cents) AS gross_profit_cents, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(gross_profit_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0), 6) AS gross_margin_rate FROM order_line_performance WHERE order_year = 2025 GROUP BY category ORDER BY net_revenue_cents DESC

SELECT product, category, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents, SUM(gross_profit_cents) AS gross_profit_cents, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(gross_profit_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0), 6) AS gross_margin_rate FROM order_line_performance WHERE order_year = 2025 GROUP BY product, category ORDER BY net_revenue_cents DESC, product

WITH yearly AS (SELECT channel, order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(refunded_order) AS refunded_orders FROM order_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY channel, order_year), rates AS (SELECT channel, order_year, 1.0 * refunded_orders / NULLIF(order_count, 0) AS refund_rate FROM yearly) SELECT channel, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN refund_rate END), 6) AS refund_rate_2024, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN refund_rate END), 6) AS refund_rate_2025, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN refund_rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN refund_rate END), 6) AS rate_change FROM rates GROUP BY channel ORDER BY rate_change DESC

WITH yearly AS (SELECT category, order_year, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS revenue, 1.0 * SUM(gross_profit_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0) AS margin_rate FROM order_line_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY category, order_year), pivoted AS (SELECT category, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2024_cents, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2025_cents, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN margin_rate END) AS margin_2024, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN margin_rate END) AS margin_2025 FROM yearly GROUP BY category) SELECT category, revenue_2024_cents, revenue_2025_cents, ROUND(1.0 * (revenue_2025_cents - revenue_2024_cents) / NULLIF(revenue_2024_cents, 0), 6) AS revenue_growth_rate, ROUND(margin_2024, 6) AS margin_2024, ROUND(margin_2025, 6) AS margin_2025, ROUND(margin_2025 - margin_2024, 6) AS margin_change FROM pivoted WHERE revenue_2025_cents > revenue_2024_cents AND margin_2025 < margin_2024 ORDER BY revenue_growth_rate DESC
SELECT city, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM order_performance WHERE order_year = 2025 GROUP BY city ORDER BY city
SELECT city, SUM(true_lost_events) AS true_lost_events, SUM(estimated_lost_revenue_cents) AS estimated_lost_revenue_cents FROM lost_demand_daily WHERE event_year = 2025 GROUP BY city ORDER BY city

SELECT order_month, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN campaign_name IS NOT NULL THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) AS campaign_revenue_cents FROM order_performance WHERE order_year = 2025 GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month

SELECT CASE WHEN campaign_name = '春节焕新' THEN 'spring_festival' ELSE 'regular' END AS period_type, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, SUM(paid_gmv_cents) AS paid_gmv_cents, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM order_performance WHERE order_year = 2025 AND (campaign_name = '春节焕新' OR campaign_name IS NULL) GROUP BY period_type ORDER BY period_type

SELECT CASE WHEN created_month IN ('2025-01', '2025-02') THEN 'spring_festival' ELSE 'regular' END AS period_type, ROUND(AVG(actual_lead_days), 4) AS avg_actual_lead_days, ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 4) AS avg_delay_days, ROUND(AVG(fill_rate), 6) AS avg_fill_rate FROM supply_performance WHERE created_year = 2025 AND actual_lead_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY period_type ORDER BY period_type

SELECT order_year, SUM(paid_gmv_cents) AS paid_gmv_cents, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(gross_profit_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0), 6) AS gross_margin_rate, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(refunded_order) / COUNT(*), 6) AS refunded_order_rate FROM order_performance WHERE campaign_name = '618' AND order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year

SELECT event_year, SUM(true_lost_events) AS true_lost_events, SUM(estimated_lost_revenue_cents) AS estimated_lost_revenue_cents FROM lost_demand_daily WHERE campaign_name = '618' AND event_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY event_year ORDER BY event_year

SELECT created_year, ROUND(AVG(actual_lead_days), 4) AS avg_actual_lead_days, ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 4) AS avg_delay_days, ROUND(AVG(fill_rate), 6) AS avg_fill_rate FROM supply_performance WHERE created_month IN ('2024-05', '2024-06', '2025-05', '2025-06') AND actual_lead_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY created_year ORDER BY created_year

SELECT CASE WHEN campaign_name = '双十一' THEN 'double11' ELSE 'regular' END AS period_type, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, SUM(paid_gmv_cents) AS paid_gmv_cents, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(discount_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_cents), 0), 6) AS discount_rate, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(refunded_order) / COUNT(*), 6) AS refunded_order_rate FROM order_performance WHERE order_year = 2025 AND (campaign_name = '双十一' OR campaign_name IS NULL) GROUP BY period_type ORDER BY period_type

WITH yearly AS (SELECT channel, order_year, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS revenue FROM order_performance WHERE campaign_name = '618' AND order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY channel, order_year), pivoted AS (SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_cents FROM yearly GROUP BY channel), deltas AS (SELECT channel, revenue_2024_cents, revenue_2025_cents, revenue_2025_cents - revenue_2024_cents AS net_revenue_delta_cents FROM pivoted) SELECT channel, revenue_2024_cents, revenue_2025_cents, net_revenue_delta_cents, ROUND(1.0 * net_revenue_delta_cents / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_delta_cents) OVER (), 0), 6) AS delta_contribution_rate FROM deltas ORDER BY net_revenue_delta_cents DESC

WITH yearly AS (SELECT category, order_year, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS revenue, 1.0 * SUM(gross_profit_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0) AS margin_rate FROM order_line_performance WHERE campaign_name = '618' AND order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY category, order_year), pivoted AS (SELECT category, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2024_cents, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2025_cents, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN margin_rate END) AS margin_2024, MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN margin_rate END) AS margin_2025 FROM yearly GROUP BY category), deltas AS (SELECT category, revenue_2024_cents, revenue_2025_cents, revenue_2025_cents - revenue_2024_cents AS net_revenue_delta_cents, margin_2024, margin_2025 FROM pivoted) SELECT category, revenue_2024_cents, revenue_2025_cents, net_revenue_delta_cents, ROUND(1.0 * net_revenue_delta_cents / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_delta_cents) OVER (), 0), 6) AS delta_contribution_rate, ROUND(margin_2024, 6) AS margin_2024, ROUND(margin_2025, 6) AS margin_2025, ROUND(margin_2025 - margin_2024, 6) AS margin_change FROM deltas ORDER BY net_revenue_delta_cents DESC
SELECT warehouse, SUM(stockout_flag) AS stockout_days FROM inventory_daily_analysis WHERE inventory_month = '2025-06' GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY stockout_days DESC

SELECT warehouse, product, category, SUM(stockout_flag) AS stockout_days FROM inventory_daily_analysis WHERE inventory_month = '2025-06' GROUP BY warehouse, product, category HAVING stockout_days > 0 ORDER BY stockout_days DESC, warehouse, product

SELECT product, category, city, channel, SUM(true_lost_events) AS true_lost_events, SUM(substituted_events) AS substituted_events, SUM(estimated_lost_revenue_cents) AS estimated_lost_revenue_cents, SUM(recovered_by_substitution_cents) AS recovered_by_substitution_cents FROM lost_demand_daily WHERE event_year = 2025 GROUP BY product, category, city, channel ORDER BY estimated_lost_revenue_cents DESC, product, city, channel

SELECT supplier, CASE WHEN created_month IN ('2025-04', '2025-05') THEN 'pre_618' WHEN created_month = '2025-06' THEN 'during_618' WHEN created_month IN ('2025-07', '2025-08') THEN 'post_618' END AS period_type, COUNT(*) AS po_lines, ROUND(AVG(actual_lead_days), 4) AS avg_actual_lead_days, ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 4) AS avg_delay_days, ROUND(AVG(fill_rate), 6) AS avg_fill_rate FROM supply_performance WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-08' AND actual_lead_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY supplier, period_type ORDER BY supplier, period_type

SELECT event_date, event_type, warehouse, product, category, delta_on_hand, after_available, reference_id FROM inventory_exception WHERE event_year = 2025 AND event_month = '2025-06' AND event_type = 'quality_hold_writeoff' ORDER BY event_date, event_id

SELECT product, warehouse, SUM(stockout_flag) AS stockout_days, MIN(available_qty) AS min_available_qty, ROUND(AVG(available_qty), 4) AS avg_available_qty FROM inventory_daily_analysis WHERE inventory_month = '2025-06' AND category = '手机' GROUP BY product, warehouse ORDER BY stockout_days DESC, product, warehouse

SELECT product, SUM(true_lost_events) AS true_lost_events, SUM(estimated_lost_revenue_cents) AS estimated_lost_revenue_cents FROM lost_demand_daily WHERE event_year = 2025 AND campaign_name = '618' AND category = '手机' GROUP BY product ORDER BY estimated_lost_revenue_cents DESC

SELECT order_year, SUM(gross_cents) AS gross_cents, SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents, SUM(paid_gmv_cents) AS paid_gmv_cents, SUM(recognized_revenue_cents) AS recognized_revenue_cents, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(discount_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_cents), 0), 6) AS discount_rate, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(refund_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(recognized_revenue_cents), 0), 6) AS refund_amount_rate FROM order_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year

SELECT order_year, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents, SUM(gross_profit_cents) AS gross_profit_cents, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(gross_profit_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0), 6) AS gross_margin_rate, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(refunded_order) / COUNT(*), 6) AS refunded_order_rate FROM order_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year

SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE -net_revenue_cents END) AS revenue_delta_cents FROM order_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY revenue_delta_cents DESC

SELECT category, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue_cents ELSE -net_revenue_cents END) AS revenue_delta_cents FROM order_line_performance WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue_delta_cents DESC

WITH lost AS (SELECT event_year AS year, SUM(estimated_lost_revenue_cents) AS lost_revenue_cents FROM lost_demand_daily WHERE event_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY event_year), stock AS (SELECT inventory_year AS year, SUM(stockout_flag) AS stockout_days FROM inventory_daily_analysis WHERE inventory_year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY inventory_year) SELECT lost.year, lost.lost_revenue_cents, stock.stockout_days FROM lost JOIN stock ON stock.year = lost.year ORDER BY lost.year

SELECT created_year, ROUND(AVG(actual_lead_days), 4) AS avg_actual_lead_days, ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 4) AS avg_delay_days, ROUND(AVG(fill_rate), 6) AS avg_fill_rate FROM supply_performance WHERE created_year IN (2024, 2025) AND actual_lead_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY created_year ORDER BY created_year
